rule: Use precedents to resolve design conflicts without inventing new canon. Stronger character/world/living-visual authorities always win.

precedents.ruling: diagnose body posture silhouette prop construction value and material before adding detail
preserve body comfort through contextual variants removable layers and practical construction
precedents.principle: resolve as situation difference, not personality deletion

precedents.ruling: move theme color into reflection emblem lining thread prop or environment
translate icon into seam fold binding repair material edge transparency or light behavior
separate identity costume rendering composition and fix only affected layer
differentiate plausible posture shoulder-torso ratio hair mass garment length leg spacing or prop position before color
use posture maintenance fastening object handling grooming and fit before visual tropes
use posture gaze styling confidence repaired objects and light relationship
increase composition lighting environment effects and rendering precision, not character ornament density
strengthen master hair mass body proportion posture brow-eye rhythm and signature shape
reject for ordinary wear; only use as justified borrowed ceremonial gift disguise or scenario exception
check project historicity, world technology, then preserve identity through silhouette and wearing behavior without casual anachronism
score identity living-visual body posture clothing world and acting before beauty
remove arbitrary novelty and derive specificity from life body era object use and relationship history
mark UNKNOWN_AUTHORING_REQUIRED or explicit AUTHOR_CANDIDATE; never model-default
compare same rendering/composition while varying one primary design axis
store literal verdict as USER_CONFIRMED and cause analysis separately as DESIGN_HYPOTHESIS
use discomfort and clothing handling as acting rather than erasing personality
share materials repair logic light behavior fastening culture and infrastructure rather than identical symbols
